goal: 60 fps interactive adjustments/filters via WebGL2 proxy preview, with full-resolution work only on commit.
constraints: Static folder app/, no build step, ES modules with .js extensions, relative paths
No CDN, no npm, no server, no SharedArrayBuffer
Core must not import from ui
Every change is a named history step; preview must not touch history until commit
Update tasks.md, progress.md, docs/FEATURES.md after each phase
Never start servers; verify by reading code and node --check

decisions.gpuThread: main thread with OffscreenCanvas; CPU work stays in compute worker
decisions.previewSizeRule: min(layerSize, viewportDevicePixels, previewMaxPixels area), never upscale
decisions.randomOpsCommit: grain and addNoise preview on GPU, commit on CPU worker for identical saved output
decisions.parityTolerance: max abs diff <= 1/255 per channel for deterministic ops
decisions.textureFormat: RGBA8 default; RGBA16F only with EXT_color_buffer_half_float

rootCauses.text: ImageData/canvas allocation and putData each tick; main-thread mixBySelection
layer.canvas swapped for a new canvas each tick
No coalescing of input events, worker backlog
Camera Raw uses separate CPU path
